vsm1.3:58.2: 16. Sīmā—“boundary”: loosely used in this sense, it corresponds vaguely to what is meant by “parish.” In the strict sense it is the actual area (usually a “chapter house”) agreed according to the rules laid down in the Vinaya and marked by boundary stones, within which the Community (saṅgha) carries out its formal acts.
vsm1.3:59.1: 17. Atthayitabba—“needed”: not in PED, not in CPD.
